essence: The ṭa-class syllable group is installed in the throat with the obeisance formula addressed to Varuṇa.
The pa-class syllable group is installed in the right hand with the obeisance formula addressed to Kubera.
One should place the huṃ-prefixed lakṣa-beginning group for Earth in the heart and feet.
The hrīṃ-trīṃ-huṃ-preceded formula should be performed as a supreme remover of sense-related faults.
One should indeed place the specified mantra in the four-petaled mūlādhāra.
